text: Horrible app, very simple made checklist where you have to pay to add more than 3 things to check off
author: Ton
developer_reply: While there is a habit limit, all the app's features are available for free. This includes tasks, habits, calendar, journal, timer, widgets, health syncing, and much more! Premium purchase is required for unlimited access to support ongoing server costs and new feature development.

text: its a simple habit tracker, nothing special, except for you need to pay to actually use it for more than 5 tasks, which is just stupid. There are no updates to be needed, it's literally just a calendar to track stuff, it shouldn't cost money, especially not a subscription based kinda thing!
author: Mitch
developer_reply: All HelloHabit features are free to use with a 5 habit limit, including all customizable tracking options, and the integrated timer, journal, calendar, interactive widgets, health sync, and web app. Due to ongoing server costs and active feature development from our team, we require a subscription for unlimited access.

text: Het mooie is dat je opmerkingen bij je habits kan zetten. Bijvoorbeeld waarom een bepaalde habit op dat moment niet is gedaan. Zelf gebruik ik het om habits en gezondheid klachten vast te leggen. Doel, onderzoek van samenhang tussen habits en gezondheid klachten.
author: Wim Klein
